items.title: Bill Phillips Interview, 1961-05-24
items.q: Were you in relation to the old bass player, you know Babe Phillips? No, I wasn't.

ctx.x: Were you in relation to the old bass player, you know Babe Phillips? No, I wasn't. Or any of the other, there's another trumpet player.

No, Joe Phillips, no, not the kid in the end. No, no, no, no. Bob Riley's his brother-in-law. My brother-in-law is Bob Riley. Poor yes. Louis Bob Riley, the one that stayed across the street here. Poor yes. Paul Bob Riley.
